main_text.head: PRECATIO ALIA:
main_text.p: Concede, Domine, propitius, ut earum virginum precibus & meritis, cum ipsis in æ-terna beatitudine collocari mereamur.
main_text.head: ALIA:
main_text.p:
Quarum orationibus
Felices cum felicibus,
Pace fruamur sedulâ,
Per sæculorum sæcula.
main_text.head: DE S. CATHARINA.
main_text.p: Deus, qui dedisti legem Mosi in summi-tate montis Sinai, & in eodem loco per Angelos tuos corpus beatæ Catharinæ virginis martyris tuæ mirabiliter collocasti, tribue quæsumus, ut ejus meritis & intercessione ad montem, qui Christus est, valeamus per-venire.

Catharina flos rosarum
Consolatrix animarum
Tuæ precis interventu
Angelorum nos concentu
Fac gaudere jugiter.

Ave viva Christi hostia,
Tua venerantibus patrocinia,
Impetrata non deneges suffragia.

page.notes: Lower margin: the word "Etiam" is followed by a reference mark; the line "Ave virginum gemma Catharina" and the lines following are set in a slightly larger italic-like type; the initial "Ꝛ" marking the hymn is partly damaged. Some letters at the right edge are obscured by staining.
